metadata.description: Property viability criteria for cross-entity cluster formation
metadata.purpose: Define thresholds and rules for selecting Wikidata properties that form well-bounded clusters

cardinality_criteria.description: Rules for acceptable cluster sizes based on entity count

absolute_bounds.rationale: Below 3 entities lacks cluster utility; above 100 becomes unwieldy for variable-K queries

constraint_adjustment_rules.description: How to adjust constraints when cluster size is out of range
too_large: Add threshold constraint (top N by metric)

wikipedia_coverage_criteria.description: Requirements for Wikipedia article availability and quality

minimum_coverage_threshold.rationale: At least 80% of cluster entities must have English Wikipedia articles

article_quality_requirements.rationale: Articles need sufficient content for meaningful passage extraction

full_coverage.description: Nearly all entities have quality Wikipedia articles

high_coverage.description: Most entities have quality Wikipedia articles

acceptable_coverage.description: Majority of entities have Wikipedia articles

insufficient_coverage.description: Too many entities lack Wikipedia articles

temporal_stability_criteria.description: How stable property values are over time, affecting query temporal anchoring

permanent.description: Property values never change once set

epoch_stable.description: Property values stable within defined historical periods

slowly_changing.description: Property values change but remain stable for years

volatile.description: Property values change unpredictably or continuously

static_membership.description: Cluster members never change (e.g., Nobel winners in a specific year)

additive_only.description: New members can be added but existing members never leave

bounded_churn.description: Membership changes but within predictable bounds

query_naturalness_criteria.description: How naturally questions can be formed about the property/cluster

enumeration.template: Who/What are all the [entities] that [property condition]?
enumeration.example: Who are all the Nobel Prize winners in Physics from 2010-2020?

attribute_collection.template: What are the [attributes] of all [entities] in [cluster]?
attribute_collection.example: What are the birth countries of all actors in The Godfather?

comparison.template: How do [entities] compare in terms of [attribute]?
comparison.example: How do EU countries compare in terms of GDP per capita?

aggregation.example: What is the total population of Scandinavian countries?

subset_identification.example: Which Fortune 500 companies are headquartered in California?

criteria: Questions feel like something a human would actually ask
Clear real-world motivation for the query
Answer provides genuine insight or utility
Questions are reasonable but somewhat contrived
Would appear in educational or research contexts
Answer is informative but not urgently needed
Answer is technically correct but not particularly useful

composite_viability_score.description: How to combine individual criteria into overall viability score

marginally_viable.recommendation: Include only if needed for coverage

property_exclusion_rules.description: Properties that should be excluded regardless of scores

automatic_exclusions.description: Properties marked as deprecated in Wikidata
Properties that are just IDs in external databases (VIAF, ISNI, etc.)
Properties pointing to images, audio, or video files
Properties for Wikidata internal use (constraint violations, etc.)

conditional_exclusions.condition: fewer than 1000 entities have this property
conditional_exclusions.exception: unless specifically curated for niche domains

conditional_exclusions.condition: property meaning varies significantly across entity types
conditional_exclusions.exception: unless filtered to single entity type

sparql_validation_queries.description: SPARQL query templates for validating viability criteria

cardinality_check.template: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?entity) AS ?count) WHERE { ?entity wdt:P31 wd:$TYPE . ?entity wdt:$PROPERTY ?value . $CONSTRAINTS }

wikipedia_coverage_check.template: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?entity) AS ?with_wiki) WHERE { ?entity wdt:P31 wd:$TYPE . ?entity wdt:$PROPERTY ?value . ?article schema:about ?entity . ?article schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . $CONSTRAINTS }
wikipedia_coverage_check.purpose: Count entities with English Wikipedia articles

temporal_distribution_check.template: SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?entity) AS ?count) WHERE { ?entity wdt:P31 wd:$TYPE . ?entity wdt:$PROPERTY ?value . ?entity wdt:$TIME_PROP ?time . BIND(YEAR(?time) AS ?year) } GROUP BY ?year ORDER BY ?year
